limitations: Actual native CLI terminals and published MCP packages were driven by operator-queued deterministic local model responses. This is not hosted-model reasoning, GUI or usability evidence.
Fresh unfunded wallets signed offline only. RPC/REST used disabled loopback endpoints; no chain or provider resources were created.
Minimal offline config omits converterAddress and faucetUrl; CosmWasm is unavailable and the faucet tool absent. Actual chain list_modules passed.
Saved schema2/3 manifests, draft and journal are synthetic fixtures. Live deployment records are separate evidence.
Legacy upgrade uses tagged0.4.0 and native remove/install under the same identity; marketplace update-in-place and other historical versions are untested.
Private-file credential migration does not establish native OS-store access, cross-machine portability or other operating systems.
Runtime dependency repair uses an isolated npm cache. Native reconnects, if needed, remain visible in the recorded terminal captures.
